• "Quixotic" means extremely idealistic, unrealistic, and impractical. Its closest synonym among the options is "idealistic". (अवास्तविक)

◦ Example: His quixotic (idealistic) plan to end world hunger single-handedly impressed people even though it seemed hopelessly unrealistic.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1 "Infused" means filled or permeated with a strong feeling or quality — different in sense from "quixotic".

• Option 2 "Torment" means to subject someone to persistent aggressive pressure, intimidation, or annoyance — different in sense from "quixotic".

• Option 3 "Peaceful" means free from disturbance or noise; calm — different in sense from "quixotic".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of quixotic: idealistic. Antonyms: practical, realistic, pragmatic.
